lines.zh: 两条后腿迈开，我走得很快。
lines.en: My two hind legs open up and I move quickly.

lines.zh: 我踏在干沙上，脚下很轻。
lines.en: My feet on the dry sand are light.

lines.zh: 绕过一丛枯草，我继续走。
lines.en: I round a clump of dry grass and keep going.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸，我看见了远处。
lines.en: Neck out, I can see the distance.

lines.zh: 我沿着孤峰脚下走了一圈。
lines.en: I walk a full lap at the base of the butte.
I sweep my tail as I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩过碎石，石子滚下去。
lines.en: I cross the scree and the pebbles roll away.
The sun's harsh, so I slow down.
I look back at the young one.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁走，那里阴凉。
lines.en: I keep to the rock face where it's shaded.

lines.zh: 我穿过枯林，枝叶刮着皮肤。
lines.en: I pass through dry scrub that scrapes my hide.
My shadow on the sand is very thin.
I turn a bend toward the water.
Every so often I stop and listen.
I stand with my neck slightly forward.
Wind comes from the butte.
I lower my head and sniff the dry earth.
The young one circles at my legs.
I chew a mouthful of coarse grass.
I look up; nothing there.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上打了个弯。
lines.en: My tail curls on the ground.

lines.zh: 前腿站酸了，我换成后腿撑着。
lines.en: My front legs ache, so my hind legs take the weight.
Too hot; I pant with my mouth open.

lines.zh: 我在数这片地上有几个能藏的地方。
lines.en: I'm counting the cover spots here.
A bug crawls over my toes.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，望向水源的方向。
lines.en: I lift my head toward the water.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，可我不放松。
lines.en: It's quiet, but I don't relax.
You're standing on my ground.

lines.zh: 我把脖子抬起来，看着你。
lines.en: I raise my neck and look at you.
My young one is behind me.
You don't look like anything from here.
I shift half a step to the side.
Come close and I'll call out.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩到了我要吃的草。
lines.en: Your foot is on the grass I mean to eat.
You're blocking the way back.

lines.zh: 我两条后腿迈开，脖子一伸。
lines.en: On two hind legs, I stretch my neck out.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我在这里等你走。
lines.en: I won't run; I'll wait here until you go.
I cry out and back off several steps.
That landed on my ribs.
I move off at an angle.

lines.zh: 血滴在干沙上，很快就干了。
lines.en: Blood on dry sand dries fast.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去护住伤处。
lines.en: I turn to shield the wound.
My panting gets worse.
Butte stone has dulled my claws.

lines.zh: 我肋骨疼，四条腿还没软。
lines.en: My ribs hurt, but my four legs still hold.
I look back for the young one.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，可我还站着。
lines.en: My legs shake, but I am still standing.
It smells sweet and fresh.
I take two steps forward.

lines.zh: 我要先看看幼崽吃不吃。
lines.en: Let me see whether the young one will eat.
This is far better than dry grass.
I approach carefully.

lines.zh: 这里很少有这样的东西。
lines.en: There's rarely anything like this here.
I take a bite and keep chewing.

lines.zh: 叶子递过来点，我就不追你。
lines.en: Push those leaves a little closer and I won't chase you.

lines.zh: 你撞了我一下，我退了半步。
lines.en: You bump me and I give half a step.
I put the young one behind me.
That nearly took me off my feet.

lines.zh: 我把宽背一转，让出半条路。
lines.en: I swing my broad back around to leave you half a path.
I guard the eggs; no one comes close.
The knock left me a bit numb.
I go around your flank.

lines.zh: 你再推，我的尾巴就扫过去。
lines.en: Push again, and my tail sweeps your way.
We walk side by side on the sand.
The young one walks between us.
She knocks against my shoulder.
We hold this ground together.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰她的鼻尖，声音很低。
lines.en: I touch her snout, keeping my call low.

lines.zh: 我们对着同一个方向看。
lines.en: We look the same way.
The wind brings her scent to me.

lines.zh: 太阳下去的时候我们靠得很近。
lines.en: At sundown we stand close.
I pick up a dry branch.
I bite it; too hard.

lines.zh: 我把果子顶到幼崽面前。
lines.en: I nose a fruit to the young one.
I dig something out of the sand.

lines.zh: 这东西不嫩，我吐回沙上。
lines.en: This is not tender; I spit it back onto the sand.
It rolled downhill; I didn't follow.
I hold it under my foot.
This eggshell is still fresh.
I bury it in the sand.

lines.zh: 矮草被我压开一条印子。
lines.en: The low grass is pressed into a trail by my hide.
I push the young one behind me.

lines.zh: 我朝幼崽那边低低地哼了一声。
lines.en: I grunt low toward my hatchlings.
At this range I can still back off.
I raise a leg, ready to kick.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，护住身后的巢。
lines.en: I turn my body sideways, guarding the nest behind.
It's hesitating; I'll hold.
One more step and I go.
I've held this ground for years.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走，一直侧着身。
lines.en: I circle it, always side-on.
It moves and I match it.
I draw it toward open ground.
It wants my rear; I'm already turned.
I call and give ground.
The young one is hidden.
My legs stay tense.
I try a light kick.
It backs off and I close in.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能踢中它侧腰的角度。
lines.en: I wait for an angle at its ribs.
My calls are getting shorter.
One more turn and I charge.
My kick lands on its leg.
I butt it in the chest.
My tail whips across and connects.
I shove it toward the slope.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬直，我整个身子撞上去。
lines.en: Hind legs straight, I drive my whole body into it.
It retreated; I didn't chase far.
My foot skidded.
It hits a rock and slides down.
I kick again.
It's down on the sand.
I check the young one.
I stand between it and my home.
I rise up out of the sand.
The first thing I see is the butte's shadow.
The ground is dry and hot.
My legs are still soft.
The wind smells of dry grass.

lines.zh: 我朝阴凉那边走了几步。
lines.en: I take a few steps toward the shade.
My shadow is pitifully short.
There are no other prints here.
A rock wall blocks the wind far off.
I lift my head; the light stings.
I steady myself slowly.
My hide scorches and the smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从孤峰上滑下去，摔得很重。
lines.en: I slide off the butte and land hard.
The blast throws me a long way.

lines.zh: 箭从侧面来，钉在我肩胛上。
lines.en: The arrow came from the side and pinned my shoulder.
Something burns in my bones.
The grass is dry and scarce; I've thinned.

lines.zh: 雷落在背上，我腿一软跪下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my legs fold.
The sand under me is gone.
